unlabelled_and_generality_review: Full versus restricted holonomy and the intrinsic immersed topology are fixed in the introduction/A.1; connected reachable total space is proved without identifying intrinsic and ambient topologies.
A.2 covers arbitrary smooth associated fibres, smooth parameter transport and complete path existence; A.3 uses full holonomy for global fixed objects.
A.4 includes rank-zero vector bundles, the frame connection from any covariant derivative, the positive cone, full tensor-pairing calculation and the orthogonal connection restriction.
B.1 permits nonconstant-rank smooth pullback maps and homomorphisms with noninjective or nonclosed image. Naturality and the exact initial-frame convention are proved.
B.2 retains a varying initial lift and its boundary term, left Maurer convention, curvature argument order and finitely piecewise C1 time regularity.
B.3 uses the full reachable curvature span with no closure, proves the local converse and invokes exact earlier full flat-transport and simply-connected trivialization proofs.
C.1-C.2 handle arbitrary finite Lie-algebra dimension, connected immersed nonclosed reduction groups, noncompact bases of any dimension at least2, and the zero-dimensional connected group.

D.1-D.3 prove the dense circle reduction topology/nonembedding, zero-initial-curvature counterexample and the compactly supported SO3 torus construction, including the required Lie-group and connectedness facts.
